title: My first game started as a simple text-based RPG. Here’s what it has become.
author: kent18730
selftext:
I’m developing my first game, A Life Forged, a life-simulation RPG where your choices shape your relationships, your battles, and ultimately your fate.  
It started as a simple text-based game. Over time, it evolved into something much more ambitious, with combat animations, relationships, town development, sieges, and reincarnation.  
I’m developing it solo with the help of AI tools.  
One of my main design goals is to create a game that’s easy to play casually but offers enough depth for players who want to take it seriously.  
It’s still a work in progress. I’d be interested to know which part of the game you find most intriguing, and whether the combat feels engaging even without direct control.

https://evan730.itch.io/gamelife

comments.author: aigamedev-mod
comments.body: u/kent18730 please share some more about how you used AI in developing this. Naming the tools or saying "made with AI" doesn't count. Rule 4 is how we keep promotional posts contributing, by having them talk about the process and how the game was made. Trying to keep the sub focused on dev. This post may be removed if it isn't updated.

replies.author: kent18730
replies.body: Thanks for clarifying Rule 4. I’ve updated the post with a more detailed breakdown of my AI-assisted development workflow, including programming, game design, asset generation, combat animation, and quality control.
